name: Australian Yogurt
siboNotes: Lactose content may feed bacterial overgrowth in SIBO patients. Consider lactose-free alternatives or limit to small portions during elimination phase.
preparationTips: Choose plain varieties without added fruit or sweeteners
Strain through cheesecloth to make Greek-style and reduce lactose content
Combine with low FODMAP fruits like strawberries or kiwi
Use as a base for savory dips with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
alternatives: Hard aged cheeses like cheddar or parmesan
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Rich in calcium for bone health
